name: Floating Spire
title: Floating Spire
summary: A floating Advocate tower hanging above a forested hilltop near Fort Tethana. It can only be entered by a portal from The Floating City's Lost Chamber, and a random Direlands portal waits inside. In the kit the hill rises to z 440 among pines, and the spire's portal spawns sit at z 508.8. The spire's own landblock (0x287A) has no WBT statics, so its shape is taken from the identical floating Advocate Spire at the Humming Crystal (0x01001776, 18.7 x 18.7 x 35.2 m). That puts it at about z 490-525, roughly 50 m above the hilltop.
